visual_encoding.reference: first price in the trailing 100-observation window
visual_encoding.bounds: Clipped at 0.01x and 100x reference; amber dots mark clipped observations
visual_encoding.interpretation: Fixed monotone sensory transform; no suggested action or P&L input

selection: Development must beat both cash and pristine frozen; no test-based selection or automatic deployment.
hypothesis: Fixed, monotone return encoding may preserve useful move magnitude missing from the original autoscaled chart. Cross original/fixed inputs with frozen/online learning while retaining full graph, decoder, costs and prior cohort.
limitations: Short indicative DEX replay with news disabled, separate phase cash and neural resets, and explicit quote gaps; not monthly-return evidence.
